caption: The drawing features two pottery vessels depicted on a light beige background. The main object, centrally placed, is a large, grayish-brown stoneware jug with a rounded body, a narrow neck, and a short, slightly flared rim. The jug is decorated with blue floral motifs that include two large daisy-like flowers with multiple petals and several leaves connected by curved stems. The texture of the jug is subtly shaded to convey its three-dimensional form and surface. In the upper right corner, there is a smaller, secondary vessel, also grayish-brown, but with a handle and a slightly more curved, elongated body. This secondary jug also has faint blue decorative elements near the handle. Both vessels are rendered with realistic shading to suggest volume and material, and the overall composition is balanced with clear space around the objects. The artist's signature, "N. Amantea," is inscribed at the bottom right corner of the image.
title: Jug
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
